programme.desc: The year is 1917 and Chen Zhen, believed to be dead, returns to Shanghai under a false name. He joins a mob boss for info on the Japanese incl. a long kill list and at night fights the Japanese masked.

programme.title: Prince Charming
programme.desc: Chen Li Pin, the nerdy son of a business tycoon, and his friend seek love in Hawaii. Returning home in disappointment, they accidentally find themselves in a messy identity swap.

programme.title: Rob-B-Hood
programme.desc: Thongs and Octopus accept a job from their landlord: kidnap a baby. Soon, the baby awakens strong paternal feelings in the two crooks, leading to complications when it comes to handing him over to his possibly crazy gang boss grandfather.

programme.title: Hong Kong Playboys
programme.desc: Sheng is a rich playboy who lives a carefree and fun life with the ladies, until his mother decides that he should get married. Up against other lady killers in his quest to find Miss Right, Sheng must decide what he wants.

programme.title: Night Watch
programme.desc: A fantasy-horror set in present-day Moscow where the respective forces that control daytime and nighttime do battle.

programme.title: Iron Kung Fu Fist
programme.desc: Liang Kun is a skilled martial arts master, he fights to avenge his lover's death with the help of a beggar gang leader.

programme.title: Open The Coffin
programme.desc: A supernatural mystery film with a detective investigating murders that seem to be the result of a curse.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: When Fortune Smiles
programme.desc: The head of a rich family dies and in his will leaves his fortune to his daughter. His son is enraged and uses a rubbish collector who looks the same as his sister to steal the fortune. The Uncle's son also wants a piece of the fortune and coerces a small time thief into stealing the will for his wild scheme.

programme.title: The Grey Men 2
programme.desc: A regime shift in Leka stirs chaos. Police send undercover Zheng Zha into Song Bang’s gang, unaware others are waiting to strike back and settle old scores.

programme.title: Ip Man 2
programme.desc: Centering on Ip Man's migration to Hong Kong in 1949 as he attempts to propagate his discipline of Wing Chun martial arts.

programme.title: Women
programme.desc: Liang Pao-erh joins the carefree Spinsters’ Club when she discovers her husband is having an affair. Despite the seemingly happy front that her sisters put on, beneath it all, each of them secretly yearns for a man in her life.

programme.title: Kungfu Stuntmen
programme.desc: The documentary highlights renowned Chinese Kung Fu masters in the film industry, showcasing Hong Kong's Kung Fu legacy over sixty years and capturing their daring lives.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Lifeline
programme.desc: The story revolves around a dutiful yet indifferent fireman, who can march into disaster and risk his lives by saving others, yet would he have the equivalent courage to tackle his personal issues?

programme.title: Kung Fu Jungle
programme.desc: Kung Fu Jungle follows a martial arts instructor who is imprisoned after a fatal accident. When a serial killer begins targeting martial arts masters, he offers his help to the police in exchange for freedom. A deadly game of skill and survival unfolds as he confronts the killer using his mastery of kung fu.

programme.title: Jealousy
programme.desc: As a man leaves his wife and daughter, a series of brief conversations, observed gestures, chance encounters and impulsive acts, tell the story of the relationships that flounder and thrive in the wake of this decision.

programme.title: The Story Of My Son
programme.desc: Li Tsu-liang is newly widowed and leading an impoverished life with two young sons. He attempts to make a fortune at the horse-racing track, but is subsequently entangled with the loan sharks.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: Love Is Love
programme.desc: A poor couple, Shui and Ti, try to make a life on their own. And through both of their hard work, Shui becomes a marketing executive, then his attitude begins to change.

programme.title: The Bare-Footed Kid
programme.desc: A young man arrives in the city to work with the friend of his dead father. When their dye shop is burnt down by a local strongman, he decides to fight back to protect all of them and save the shop.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire
programme.desc: The planned reburial of a town elder goes awry as the corpse resurrects into a hopping, bloodthirsty vampire, targeting everyone responsible for digging the grave. A Taoist Priest and his two disciples attempt to stop the terror.

programme.title: Final Justice
programme.desc: A cop relies on a young car thief to take down four gangsters, who plan to rob a rich merchant for a large amount of money.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: Teenage Dreamers
programme.desc: This refreshing musical comedy tempers its fizzy charm with just enough tartness to insure its charming buoyancy. This light look at teenage life even won starlet Chou Hsiu-lan a Hong Kong Film Awards nomination for Best Newcomer.

programme.title: Fight Back To School 2
programme.desc: Sing quits the force after getting demoted to traffic duties, while his partner is assigned a mission involving foreign terrorists threatening to bomb a school in Hong Kong, so Sing decides to help by going undercover at the same school.

programme.title: Cruel War
programme.desc: The story is about a powerful drug-lord in southeast Asia, and the good guys have to save their loved ones under the threat of the Drug business conspiracy.

programme.title: Behind The Yellow Line
programme.desc: Behind The Yellow Line

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

programme.title: Shinjuku Incident
programme.desc: A simple Chinese immigrant wages a perilous war against one of the most powerful criminal organizations on the planet.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: King Of Beggars
programme.desc: A rich family's son falls in love with a woman who will only marry him once he becomes a Kung-Fu Master. In this 'Dramedy' He becomes a legendary hero, by attempting to save the emperor, during his true quest of love.

programme.title: Si Bocil Trang Quynh
programme.desc: Kisah Lucu Dan Jenaka Tentang Kehidupan Quynh Dan Orang-Orang Disekitarnya. Sebagai Anak Yang Nakal Tetapi Cerdas Dan Banyak Akal, Quynh Dan Teman-Temannya Akan Membawa Pengalaman Hidup Yang Penuh Warna Di Pedesaan Vietnam Pada Abad Ke-18. Menyoroti Juga Tentang Nilai-Nilai Budaya Rakyat Dan Hubungan Dengan Keluarga, Teman, Guru, Siswa, Dan Lingkungan. Trang Quynh Akan Membawa Tawa Bagi Penonton Dan Mengajarkan Mereka Tentang Keintiman, Persahabatan, Dan Nilai-Nilai Kemanusiaan.

programme.title: Traffic Safety With Poli
programme.desc: Serial Animasi Menceritakan Tentang Karakter Ambulans Baik Hati Bernama Amber Dari Tim Penyelamat Robocar Poli. Ia Ditugaskan Untuk Membantu Anak-Anak Dan Teman-Teman Kecil Seperti Peter, Johnny, Cindy, Dan Charles Yang Sering Menghadapi Situasi Berbahaya Saat Bermain Atau Beraktivitas.

programme.title: Metal Cardbot
programme.desc: Dahulu Kala, Terdapat Sebuah Planet Bernama Machina Dimana Metal Cardbots Tinggal. Suatu Ketika, Planet Ini Tiba-Tiba Meledak Dan Memaksa Semua Penghuninya Untuk Hidup Di Bumi. Agar Tidak Menarik Perhatian Makhluk Bumi, Cardbots Menyamar Sebagai Kendaraan Sehari-Hari. Hingga Suatu Hari, Seorang Anak Sekolah Dasar Yang Bernama Jun Secara Tidak Sengaja Menemukan Metal Breath, Dengan Metal Breath Tersebut Dia Bisa Menangkap Dan Menyalakan Cardbots Dengan Kemampuan Yang Berbeda.

programme.title: Boboiboy
programme.desc: Sebuah Program Animasi Yang Mengisahkan Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Yakni Gopal, Ying, Dan Yaya Yang Masing-Masing Memiliki Kekuatan Super. Dengan Kekuatan Yang Dimiliki Mereka Mencegah Adu Du Mencuri Biji Kakao Tok Aba Yang Digunakan Sebagai Sumber Energi. Selain Itu, Boboiboy Dan Teman-Temannya Menjadi Pahlawan Super Dalam Menumpas Kejahatan Dan Menjaga Kedamaian Bumi.

programme.title: Blox Buster

Tidak Hanya Sekadar Bermain, Main Bareng Blox Juga Menyuguhkan Pengalaman Unik Dari Para Gamers Yang Ikut Serta, Mulai Dari Review Game, Tips Seru, Hingga Momen-Momen Kejutan Yang Terjadi Saat Bermain.

Dipandu Oleh Tiga Host Utama Yaitu Komandan Zack, Bro Dim, Dan Miss Binal, Setiap Episodenya Juga Menghadirkan Berbagai Cameo Menarik Seperti Tahanan, Petugas Kebersihan, Hingga Karakter Unik Lainnya Yang Menambah Keseruan.
